dayEvents.description: The royal cartographers have spotted strange lights beneath the waves near the eastern coast. The court scholars believe it might be the lost Temple of the Deep.

choices.description: Send an elite team of divers to explore the underwater ruins.

phaseInfo.scenarioDesc: Diving into the abyssal ruins of the Sunken Temple.

choices.description: Keep the team on the surface and search the nearby beaches and cliffs.

phaseInfo.description: Patrolling the rocky shores and coastal caves.

choices.description: It is too risky. The sea is not our domain.
